families.label: Sheet / dialog chrome
families.rationale: React uses Modal; React Native uses BottomSheet. Same job, platform-native pattern — not a missing port.

families.label: Floating web chrome
families.rationale: Popover is a web overlay pattern. React Native does not need a Popover port unless we explicitly decide otherwise. Tooltip is not in either package yet — do not treat it as an exception until it exists in Figma or code.
